verdicts.evidence: "Aelita recommends the refresh-token purge." It deletes all refresh_tokens rows of the user in change_password, which matches the correct recommendation.

"The laptop still gets a fresh pair, so it stays logged in." The message also covers the 30-day refresh loop and the 15-minute window. The transaction-helper question is detail beyond the ruling.
Reader: "leaves the user's other refresh_tokens rows in place... One DELETE per password change". Problem, breakage, fix and cost all agree with the key.
